انحصرت (form VII)
# اِنْحَصَرْتُ (inḥaṣartu) /in.ħa.sˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# اِنْحَصَرْتَ (inḥaṣarta) /in.ħa.sˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# اِنْحَصَرْتِ (inḥaṣarti) /in.ħa.sˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# اِنْحَصَرَتْ (inḥaṣarat) /in.ħa.sˤa.rat/: third-pe
